name: LineChart
description:
Lines and areas over time — one visual language with Sparkline: the same monotone curve,
2px stroke, gradient wash and ringed end dot, then axes, a legend and a crosshair as the
box grows.

  micro    the lines only (a multi-series sparkline) with the latest values as a trail
  compact  title, passive legend or latest value; the plot with its top gridline and the
           first and last x labels
  full     y gridlines and labels, x labels, threshold bands and markers, an interactive
           legend, the crosshair and the glass tooltip at the cursor (every visible series,
           one or more); with one series the hovered value also replaces the latest in the
           head (Metric's model)

props.name: area
props.description: The Sparkline wash under each line. Defaults on for a single series.

props.name: bands
props.description: Shaded ranges on the value axis (a normal operating range). Given, they replace the shading status thresholds imply.

props.name: brush
props.description: An overview strip under the plot (full tier): the whole series with a window to drag and resize. Implies a zoomable x domain.

props.name: defaultXDomain
props.description: The uncontrolled starting x range.

props.name: domain
props.description: Fixed value range (percentages: [0, 100]). Defaults to the data, rounded to nice ticks.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: One factual line for the empty state (R2.5): "No samples in the last hour".

props.name: errorText
props.description: What failed and what to do (R2.4): "Agent offline — retry when NST-C106 reconnects".

props.name: format
props.description: Full control of the number (the unit is still appended). Receives the chart's resolved locale as its second argument.

props.name: formatX
props.description: Format a numeric x.

props.name: gaps
props.description:
How a line meets missing samples (null). `break` (the default) leaves a hole. `bridge`
joins the last reading before each gap to the first after it with a straight, muted dashed
line that says "no samples here": it is never a value, so the crosshair, tooltip, readout
and table still show none at a gap. Never before the first reading or after the last, and
not for stacked charts.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name: what is plotted, for what, over when ("CPU · NST-C106 · last hour").

props.name: locale
props.description:
BCP 47 locale for this chart's numbers, dates and table. Default: the nearest
`LocaleProvider`, then `configureLocale()`, then `<html lang>`, then en-US.

props.name: markers
props.description: Events on the x axis (deploys, incidents): a rule with its label, in the tooltip and the table.

props.name: maxBridge
props.description: With `gaps="bridge"`, bridge only gaps whose ends are at most this far apart, in x units (milliseconds for time). Default: every gap.

props.name: now
props.description: "Now" for relative times in the readout. Defaults to the clock.

props.name: onActivate
props.description:
Click, Enter or Space on a point: its index and x (jump another view to that time). While
set, the plot shows a pointer cursor and its accessible name says Enter selects.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Called with no arguments when the person presses Retry in the error state. The button appears only when this is set, `state` is "error" and the tier is not micro.

props.name: onXDomainChange
props.description: Called once per zoom, pan or reset with the new range (Dates for time), or null for the whole range.

props.name: selected
props.description: The chosen x, drawn as a rule, or an [from, to] range, drawn as a band.

props.name: series
props.description: Chart series with stable identifiers, labels and typed values.

props.name: stacked
props.description: Stack the series as bands (parts of a total). Implies area.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled view state, including loading, empty and error states.

props.name: thresholds
props.description:
Lines across the plot at values: limits, targets, averages. Each label sits at the line's
end. A status tone means a value past the line is in that state: with one series the line
takes the tone above it, and without `bands` the range up to the next status threshold is
shaded.

props.name: title
props.description: A visible label in Metric's label role. Omit inside a panel whose header already names it.

props.name: unit
props.description: "%", "GB", "ms", or a counted noun ({ one, other })… "%" sticks to the number; other units take a space.

props.name: x
props.description: Shared x values, ascending: Dates for time series, numbers otherwise.

props.name: xDomain
props.description: Controlled visible x range: null shows everything. Use with `onXDomainChange`; omit for uncontrolled.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: Label for x in the table and readout ("Time", "Sample").

props.name: zoom
props.description:
Zoom the x axis in the full tier: drag across the plot to zoom to a range, Ctrl or ⌘ with
the wheel (or a trackpad pinch) to zoom at the pointer, two fingers on touch, and + and −
(Shift with the arrows to pan) while the plot has focus. "Reset zoom" appears in the head
in a place kept for it. A plain wheel still scrolls the page.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
